svg.aria-label: ConcurrentHashMap spread function and the reserved sign bit: h XOR h unsigned-shift-right 16, masked with HASH_BITS 0x7fffffff which clears bit 31, worked through a concrete 32-bit example, alongside the three reserved negative hashes MOVED -1, TREEBIN -2 and RESERVED -3
svg.text: spread() and the Reserved Sign Bit
static int spread(int h) { return (h ^ (h >>> 16)) & HASH_BITS; } — :696-698 · HASH_BITS = 0x7fffffff — :594
Reserved negative hashes (top bit set — never produced by spread)
spread() always clears bit 31, so ordinary hashes are >= 0 — these three constants use bit 31 for special node types
